misprints.note: Accent misplaced in print (t. ex. πόταμον); kept as printed.
Headword printed with a turned n (u) in the letterspaced type; kept as printed.
No full stop after 'l' in print; kept.
Full stop between the two verbs missing in print; kept.

uncertain.note: The acute on ί and the rough breathing on ἡ have slipped down out of the line in print (they appear below the line before), so the 'νια, η.' line looks bare; transcribed as the intended ἀτονία, ἡ.
Italic 'vv' (verben) looks like Greek υυ/νυ; transcribed as Latin 'vv.' following the abbreviation list. Other pages are inconsistent (νυ, υυ, υν).
